title: Certificate Maker NFT
tagline: A dapp where users can use certificate template to create certificate and upload it to IPFS
description: A dapp where users can create certificates and upload it to IPFS.  The certificates can be NFT.  User can use certificate borders that are created by designers.  Designers can earn cryptos when someone used their certificate borders to mint NFT of certificates.  User will to get purchase membership to see all  certificate borders.
how_its_made: I built the front end with react and use semantic-ui for styling.  I build the back end with node.js with express for creating certificate.  I used slate.host to store the certificate borders on IPFS.  I also use nft.storage to store certificate that were created on the server.  I created the contracts using Solidity with Openzeppelin ERC-721.  I used Unlock's Paywall to get user to pay membership to access all certificate templates.  I deployed the contract on Polygon Testnet for cheap gas fee.
